title: Podcaster
summary: A listening hub: explain the show, make following easy, and separate selected episodes from guest and sponsor enquiries.

cards.purpose: Explain the show’s subject, host and audience before the subscription request.
One primary follow action, plus other listening formats.
Three or four episodes with number, duration and a concrete topic.
Other listening platforms and the complete episode archive.
Guest and sponsorship enquiries, separate from listener actions.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: Who is this page for, what do you make or offer, and what should a new visitor understand first?
slots.write: Use a short descriptive heading and two sentences: identify the person or group, the work and the audience. The header shows only the name; this card must explain the purpose. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Where should people follow the show first? Share the show's links and its RSS feed if public.
slots.write: Heading = the schedule; first button = the platform they prefer (subscribe preset). Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which three or four episodes should a new listener hear?
slots.write: tag = episode number · length; title exactly as published; description = the guest and their role, as credited. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which platforms is the show on? Paste the show pages.
slots.write: Show page URLs only. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you take guest pitches or sponsors? Which address may be public?
slots.write: Text = what a good pitch looks like and how sponsorship works, in their words. Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Anything listeners should know about you or how the show is made?
slots.write: Two or three sentences, including how the show is funded if they say. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
